title: Identity of explicit raw cohomology pullback
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $k:W\to S$ a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $W$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $q\in\mathbf Z$ and $U\to S$ etale. Use the raw groups and explicit pullbacks of [sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-over-naturality]. For each scheme $A$ over $W$ and each $z\in P_A(U)$, the raw pullback of the identity of $A$ sends $z$ to itself. No additivity or composition assertion is part of this statement, and no limit or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Let P be inverse image along the identity of A.left and e = upperStarId. The left unit law upperStarComp_id_left identifies the source comparison with e.inv and the coefficient comparison with e.hom. Prove the two component equalities separately and supply them to single_identity_transport_of_eq, avoiding dependent rewrites of the whole scheme-level formula.

Use the fixed comparison tau = mapDerivedCategoryNatIso(e) followed by mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. Its factorization on Q(K) is P.mapDerivedCategoryFactors followed by Q of the termwise e and complex identity comparison. The latter commutes with all integer shifts degreewise. Full faithfulness of precomposition with localization reflects shift compatibility, by Localization.natTrans_ext and cancellation of the localization shift comparison. Restrict to D-plus: the image of the bounded-below comparison under the faithful inclusion is the full derived comparison conjugated by mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility and the two unitors. These comparisons commute with shift, so NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerRight proves shift compatibility on D-plus. Import all Sheaf.Paper.DerivedEtaleCohomologyPullbackLaws to use its already proved private idFactors, and import all Sheaf.CategoryTheory.ExtExactFunctorIdentityComparison to use CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.commShift_of_localization; neither helper is restated.

Use the already proved private single_iso_id from import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageTransitionIdentity to compute the component of tau on each single complex: mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor.hom followed by single(e.hom). Apply the faithful inclusion into D, then the exact functor and identity factorization equations. On complexes the equality is degreewise: in degree zero both components are e.hom, elsewhere the target is zero. For z, shift compatibility turns the shifted target factors into tau on the shifted target; naturality moves tau to the source. Substitute the single-complex computation there, cancel the inverse/direct single comparison, combine the two single maps by map_comp, cancel e.inv followed by e.hom, and apply map_id. This proves the original raw identity formula in every integer degree.

theorem higherDirectImageRawOverPullback_id
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)

    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q A).obj (op U)) :
    higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q (𝟙 A) U z = z
